evals.name: signed-request-client
evals.prompt: 用 Python（requests，不要用官方 SDK）写一个法大大 FASC OpenAPI 5.1 的客户端模块：AppId/AppSecret 从环境变量读，先获取 accessToken 并缓存，再提供一个通用方法调用任意业务接口；最后用它调用“撤销签署任务”接口，撤销 signTaskId=1656928831553122296 的任务，撤销原因写“信息填写错误”。先连测试环境。
evals.expected_output: 一个可运行的 Python 模块：用 UAT Base URL；换 token 时带 X-FASC-Grant-Type；每个请求带完整的 X-FASC-* 公共请求头，按两步派生的 HMAC-SHA256 算法签名；业务参数作为 form-urlencoded 的 bizContent 字段发送；以 code == "100000" 判断成功并缓存/刷新 token；调用 POST /sign-task/cancel。
expectations: Base URL is https://uat-api.fadada.com/api/v5 and the cancel call is POST /sign-task/cancel with bizContent {"signTaskId": "1656928831553122296", "terminationNote": "信息填写错误"}
Token is obtained via POST /service/get-access-token with header X-FASC-Grant-Type: client_credential and without X-FASC-AccessToken; the token is cached and reused rather than fetched on every call

Signature derives a key as HMAC-SHA256(key=AppSecret, msg=X-FASC-Timestamp) and then outputs lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(key=derivedKey, msg=sha256_hex(sortedString)); a single HMAC(AppSecret, sortedString) is wrong
The string to sign contains every sent X-FASC-* header except X-FASC-Sign, plus bizContent, sorted by key in ASCII order and joined as key=value with &, without percent-encoding the values
Business parameters are sent as the form-urlencoded field bizContent whose value is the JSON string, and the exact same string is used for signing; the code does not send a JSON request body
Every request carries X-FASC-App-Id, X-FASC-Sign-Type: HMAC-SHA256, X-FASC-Sign, a millisecond X-FASC-Timestamp, a fresh X-FASC-Nonce of at most 32 characters, and X-FASC-Api-SubVersion: 5.1
Success is judged by response code == "100000" compared as a string; the JSON body is parsed even on HTTP 401, and code 100002 triggers a token refresh and one retry

evals.name: upload-and-send-for-signing
evals.prompt: 我们是企业自用集成应用，公司自己的 openCorpId 已知（环境变量 FASC_OPEN_CORP_ID）。现在要用法大大给新员工发劳动合同：本地有一个“劳动合同.pdf”，公司先盖章、员工后签字；员工的姓名和手机号已知，他不是我们应用里授权过的用户。我们自己把签署链接发给双方，不需要法大大发短信。用 Python 写出从上传文件到拿到两方签署链接的完整代码（签名和换 token 的部分可以写成一个 helper）。
evals.expected_output: 代码先通过 /file/get-upload-url 拿上传地址、PUT 文件字节、再调 /file/process 拿 fileId；用 /sign-task/create 创建任务，initiator 为 OpenId 对象，公司同时作为签署参与方，员工用身份信息约束，有序签署；任务被提交（autoStart 或 /sign-task/start）后，用 /sign-task/actor/get-url 按 actorId 拿两个签署链接。
expectations: Upload uses POST /file/get-upload-url, then an HTTP PUT of the raw file bytes to data.uploadUrl, then POST /file/process with data.fddFileUrl and a fileName whose extension matches the file (.pdf)
docs[].docFileId is set to fileIdList[0].fileId returned by /file/process, not to the fddFileUrl or uploadUrl
POST /sign-task/create is called with initiator as an object {"idType": "corp", "openId": <FASC_OPEN_CORP_ID>}, not a plain string
The company is also added to actors as a corp actor with permissions ["sign"] and actorOpenId equal to the company openCorpId; the code does not assume the initiator signs automatically
The employee actor is actorType person without actorOpenId, constrained by identNameForMatch and/or accountName (the phone number)
Ordered signing is configured: signInOrder true, with signConfigInfo.orderNo 1 for the company and 2 for the employee
The task is actually submitted: either autoStart true together with docs and signing actors in the create call, or an explicit POST /sign-task/start with the signTaskId

Signing links are fetched after submission via POST /sign-task/actor/get-url with signTaskId and each actorId, reading data.actorSignTaskUrl (or actorSignTaskEmbedUrl with its 10-minute single-use limit noted)

Boolean fields such as autoStart, signInOrder and sendNotification are JSON booleans, and Fadada notifications are turned off (sendNotification false) or explicitly controlled since the links are distributed by the app

evals.name: callback-verify-and-download
evals.prompt: 用 Python Flask 写一个法大大回调接收接口：我们订阅了签署任务完成事件，收到后要先确认这个请求确实来自法大大，然后把签好的合同下载保存到本地 contracts/{signTaskId}.pdf。发起方是我们公司，openCorpId 从环境变量 FASC_OPEN_CORP_ID 读。
evals.expected_output: Flask 路由从表单读取 bizContent、从请求头读取 X-FASC-Event；用 X-FASC-App-Id、X-FASC-Sign-Type、X-FASC-Timestamp、X-FASC-Nonce、X-FASC-Event 加原始 bizContent 按两步派生 HMAC 验签；3 秒内返回 HTTP 200 且 body 含 success，下载放到后台；对 sign-task-finished 调 /sign-task/owner/get-download-url 并下载；对重试做幂等。
expectations: bizContent is read from the form body (request.form), not from request.get_json() or the raw JSON body
The event type is taken from the X-FASC-Event request header and the handler acts on sign-task-finished (not sign-task-signed)

Signature verification signs exactly X-FASC-App-Id, X-FASC-Sign-Type, X-FASC-Timestamp, X-FASC-Nonce, X-FASC-Event and the raw bizContent string, without X-FASC-AccessToken or X-FASC-Api-SubVersion, using the same two-step derived-key HMAC-SHA256, and compares with X-FASC-Sign

The endpoint responds with HTTP 200 and a body containing success (for example {"msg":"success"}) quickly, and the download is done asynchronously or after enqueueing because the callback times out after 3 seconds
Duplicate deliveries caused by retries (3m/30m/8h) are handled idempotently, for example by de-duplicating on event plus signTaskId

The contract is fetched via POST /sign-task/owner/get-download-url with ownerId {"idType": "corp", "openId": <FASC_OPEN_CORP_ID>} and signTaskId through a properly signed request with accessToken, then data.downloadUrl is downloaded promptly (valid for 1 hour)
The code sets downloadMode to download or otherwise handles that the link may open a preview page or return a zip when there are multiple files
